audit.claim_boundary: The rows are an exact tau=5 control. They do not establish any profile restriction for hypothetical tau>=6 systems.
audit.general_lemma: For a minimum cover C of H-e, each c in C has an edge meeting C exactly at c. If all such edges share v in e, then C-c+v covers H.

claim_boundary: This proves that raw local part occupancy is non-discriminating in the chosen equality control. It does not rule out a global all-witness incidence invariant, prove Ryser, or restrict hypothetical tau>=6 systems.

cycle_decision.companion_advice: Seal narrowly and pivot to the exact six-partition global-cover formulation.
cycle_decision.decision: Do not overfit a local witness profile; move to pair co-clustering across six partitions.
cycle_decision.falsifier: A replay with fewer than 64 distinct profiles falsifies this record.

outcome: The 13-edge tau=5 equality control realizes 64 distinct minimum deletion-cover part profiles.
